digest.component_or_area: alert_store atomic write and binding snapshot commit
propositions: alert_store._atomic_write hand-rolls tempfile+os.replace instead of delegating to the shared fsutil.atomic_write seam, creating parity inconsistency with projects_store
alert_store writes to local-scratch bridge_state/bridge_alerts (git-ignored, untracked on tickets branch) so fsutil.atomic_write alone is correct with no commit/publish path required

binding-snapshot conversion to push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch fails idempotency because the seam's git add -A stages .bridge_state/last-pass.json and other per-pass files excluded by the original selective 5-file staging, causing spurious commits on unchanged passes

alert_store conversion preserves exact on-disk bytes, 0o600 mode, and fsync-before-replace durability by retaining explicit parent mkdir and calling fsutil.atomic_write(path, content, permissions=0o600, fsync=True)
binding-snapshot path must remain on raw selective-staging implementation to preserve reconcile idempotency guarantee (no redundant commit when mutation_count==0 on second pass)
